<description>
In `Consensus::CheckTxInputs`, for every input coin, if either `coin.out.nValue` or `nValueIn` is out of range, the transaction is invalid. The current `checktxinputs_invalid_transactions_test` only cover cases with one input, so the sum `nValueIn` is always equal to `coin.out.nValue`, leaving the [following mutant](https://mutanthub.space/mutants/275) alive.
```diff
--- a/src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp
+++ b/src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp
@@ -189,7 +189,7 @@ bool Consensus::CheckTxInputs(const CTransaction& tx, TxValidationState& state,

         // Check for negative or overflow input values
         nValueIn += coin.out.nValue;
-        if (!MoneyRange(coin.out.nValue) || !MoneyRange(nValueIn)) {
+        if (!MoneyRange(coin.out.nValue) && !MoneyRange(nValueIn)) {
             return state.Invalid(TxValidationResult::TX_CONSENSUS, "bad-txns-inputvalues-outofrange");
         }
     }
```
https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36686/commits/f8c6cd84e08043f206ca338d0ba7e4dc8bef5214 adds support for multiple inputs in the test helper.

https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36686/commits/5d93087c6abbda758baf3d49c552e6dc259d5021 adds a test case with multiple valid inputs, whose sum exceed `MAX_MONEY`, while also having `nValueIn` != `coin.out.nValue`, killing the mutant.
</description>

<commits>
f8c6cd84e0 test: support multiple inputs in CheckTxInputs test helper

Accept a list of input values and create a distinct coin and prevout for each one. Keep the existing test cases as single-input transactions with no change in behaviour.

5d93087c6a test: cover cumulative input value range in CheckTxInputs

Add two inputs that are individually within range, but exceed MAX_MONEY when summed.
</commits>
